items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee narrates a story about Lester Young ('Prez') and Herschel Evans, stating 'Prez told Herschel... Herschel said...'. The interviewee (Leonard Phillips) is not present in the anecdote as a participant, but rather as a narrator of events involving other musicians.

ctx.x: That's interesting. King Oliver said he liked him, and he told Red Allen about him.

And when he got to Kansas City, Fletcher Henderson picked him. Hawk had left and went home'. See, he lived in St. Joseph, about 35-40 miles away from Kansas City. So he went over there, and Fletcher Henderson was asking could he get a tenor player to play for him that night in Hawkins' place. Herschel said...
